original.statement: The external-secrets.io v1beta1 ClusterExternalSecret schema gained a new field spec.externalSecretSpec.refreshPolicy (chart 0.15.0 → 0.16.0), described as determining how the ExternalSecret should be refreshed (CreatedOnce, Periodic, OnChange).

decision.reason: [ev-9beeb11a214a] shows that refreshPolicy is a new field under spec.externalSecretSpec in the v1beta1 schema of clusterexternalsecrets.external-secrets.io between 0.15.0 and 0.16.0. Nothing in the evidence describes an effect on existing resources. So the only environments the change reaches are those that use ClusterExternalSecret external-secrets.io/v1beta1, which is the proposed gvk-in-use condition. No canonical shape exists for an added crd-field, so this scoping is a judgement and not something the evidence states directly.
